_comment: Hand-maintained mapping from OVH's AI Endpoints catalog to pricing.json entries.
Nothing here is inferred at runtime: no fuzzy matching, no lowercasing and hoping.
'catalog_id' is compared byte-for-byte against the 'id' field of a catalog entry
in the page's embedded model data, and each field's 'price_unit' byte-for-byte
against that entry's metadata.usage_information.pricing[].price_unit. A catalog
that no longer contains a matching id, or a pricing entry with that exact unit,
is a failure to report, never a row to guess at.
Unlike Mistral's page, OVH's catalog_id is believed to already BE the API model
id (it appears in the model's own dedicated endpoint subdomain, e.g. gpt-oss-120b
-> gpt-oss-120b.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net). Kept as a separate field from
the pricing.json key anyway, structurally parallel to Mistral's page_name, in case
that assumption stops holding -- revisit if OVH ever renames a catalog id without
the API model id changing along with it.
Two things deliberately NOT in this file, checked against the catalog on
2026-08-03 by a human, both revisit-worthy:
Requested but absent from the live catalog: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct,
Qwen3-32B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506. None appear anywhere on the
page, under any id or alias. Not added -- there is nothing to map them to.
Add them once OVH actually publishes them.
Present but excluded: nvr-tts-it-it, nvr-tts-en-us, nvr-tts-de-de, nvr-tts-es-es.
The catalog lists all four with metadata.usage_information.pricing = [{"price":
0, "price_unit": "million_input_chars"}], and the page renders their price
block as the literal word "Gratuit" (free), not a numeric price -- OVH is
stating these are free, not that pricing data is missing. check_price's floor
of 0.001 would reject a literal 0 as a parsing accident, and treating a genuine
free tier as a special case would need a schema concept this file does not have.
Simplest honest choice: leave them unmapped and unpublished until OVH prices
them, at which point adding them is the same three-line diff as any other model.
Last verified against the catalog by a human: 2026-08-03.
